a1
Abraham traveled south and lived for a time in Gerar.
b1
Afraid for his life, he told people Sarah was his sister, and King Abimelech took her into his house.
b2
That night, God spoke to Abimelech in a dream: you will die, for this woman is married.
c1
Abimelech had not touched her. He said: Lord, will you destroy an innocent people?
c2
God answered: I kept you from sinning. Return her to her husband, a prophet. He will pray for you, and you will live.
d1
In the morning, Abimelech called Abraham: what have you done to us?
d2
Abraham said: I thought no one here feared God, and they would kill me for my wife.
d3
He added that she was truly his half-sister.
e1
Abimelech returned Sarah, and gave Abraham sheep, cattle, and servants.
e2
Abraham prayed, and God healed Abimelech's household.
h1
Abraham was afraid, and let others believe Sarah was only his sister.
h2
Yet God protected Sarah, and the promise.
h3
Fear tempts us to hide the truth. God's faithfulness does not depend on our perfect record.
h4
Today, choose honesty, and trust God with the outcome.
i
Where has fear made you less than honest?
